description: This file contains the implementation of Drupal hooks related to the taxonomy module, including help text, local task alterations, entity operations, and taxonomy indexing functions.

classes.name: TaxonomyHooks
classes.description: Implements Drupal hooks for taxonomy functionalities such as help text, local task modifications, entity operations, and taxonomy indexing.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides contextual help content for taxonomy-related pages based on route name.

methods.name: localTasksAlter
methods.description: Alters local tasks for taxonomy vocabularies, specifically changing the base route for configuration translation overview.

methods.name: entityOperation
methods.description: Defines additional operations for taxonomy terms, such as adding a child term.

methods.name: nodeInsert
methods.description: Handles node insertion to update taxonomy index.

methods.name: nodeUpdate
methods.description: Handles node updates to refresh taxonomy index, skipping non-default revisions.

methods.name: nodePredelete
methods.description: Cleans up taxonomy index entries when nodes are deleted.

methods.name: taxonomyTermDelete
methods.description: Removes taxonomy index entries when a term is deleted, if configured.
